from pathlib import Path
import difflib, hashlib, json, subprocess, tempfile
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
patch = (root / 'director-referral-candidate.diff').resolve()
expected = '17cc9de7d7d8e93b4946fe2f5930181460de70e683d2b837012814dd82a68248'
source = next((path for path in root.rglob('*.md') if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected), None)
if source is None:
    raise SystemExit('The hash-matched original README is missing from the selected inputs.')
original = source.read_bytes()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as workdir:
    readme = Path(workdir) / 'README.md'
    readme.write_bytes(original)
    for options in (['--check'], []):
        subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', *options, str(patch)], cwd=workdir, check=True)
    revised = readme.read_bytes()
changes = [line for line in difflib.ndiff(original.decode().splitlines(), revised.decode().splitlines()) if line.startswith(('+ ', '- '))]
heading = ''
for line in revised.decode().splitlines():
    if line.startswith('#'):
        heading = line
    if 'globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev' in line:
        break
assert len(changes) == 1 and changes[0].startswith('+ - [SQLite Statement Diagnostic](') and 'autonomous AI agents' in changes[0]
assert heading.lstrip('# ').strip().lower() == 'misc', heading
report = {'source': str(source), 'source_sha256': expected, 'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'section': heading, 'changes': changes, 'scope': 'Offline patch applicability against captured README. Current upstream rules and operator authorization require separate evidence.'}
out = root / 'offline-referral-apply-verification.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
